content:
Amazon is now shipping pre-orders for the new HomeView even faster than Apple is (most models still arriving on release day) and we are now tracking the return of the pre-order discount on the brand new Apple TV 4K (Amazon is still shipping this one on release day too). All of that joins the $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, up to $149 off the new M6 Mac mini, and we have exclusive discounts on a few different leather iPhone Duo cases to scope out below as well.

Land a solid deal on Apple’s best buds to pair with your Duo: AirPods Pro 3 now $50 off

It has been all about Amazon’s early pre-order discounts on Apple’s brand new HomeView (it is also still shipping the next-gen Apple TV 4K much sooner than Apple can), but this morning we are circling back to the wonderful AirPods Pro 3. You can still score Apple’s best AirPods at $50 off via Amazon.

Amazon is currently offering Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 down at $199 shipped.

Regularly $249, this is $50 off and the best deal around right now.

We were tracking AirPods Pro 3 at $179 during the fall Prime Day and we might see that deal return as soon as next month with the Black Friday festivities, but if you’re looking to land a set now they are sitting within $20 of the special holiday price.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)

Amazon is shipping the new Apple TV 4K faster, and at a lower price

While it appears some iPhone Duo pre-orders are actually going to arrive sooner than it initially seemed, delivery times are slipping on the new HomeView as we detailed this morning, much like the new Apple TV 4K. Not only is Amazon delivering the next-gen Apple TV 4K faster than Apple in most cases, but it is also selling it for less.

Amazon has brought back its early pre-order discount on Apple TV 4K at $289.99 shipped.

That of course is not a giant discount or anything, but it is certainly less than buying it at Apple and now Amazon is likely to ship it to you faster than Apple can as well.

  • NEW Apple TV 4K (4th Generation) $289 (Reg. $300)
  • NEW Apple TV Siri Remote (4th Generation) $59

Unless you have some Apple Store credit or gift cards to make use of, it seems that scoring one at Amazon is a total no brainer at this point – faster and cheaper.

Rare deal has M4 Mac mini down at $649, new M6 still up to nearly $150 off

As part of its Deals of the Day, Best Buy is offering the most affordable M4 Mac mini configurations down at $649 shipped. While you can still score some notable deals on the new M6 Mac mini models at up to nearly $150 off, those are starting at $780 and the M4 mini is still a more than capable machine.

While this M4 model did also see a price increase earlier this year, and there was a time when this model was less expensive than it is now, it is still one of the lowest points of entry to a relatively modern headless Mac machine.

There are some refurbished listings out there, but Best Buy is delivering a brand new condition unit at $131 under the sale price on the most affordable new M6 model here. For the record, the official Apple Refurbished Store is completely out of stock on Mac mini at the time of writing.

There is some solid value left in the M4 mini – I am still running one and it is great. However, at this point I might prefer to just splurge on the more powerful M6 mini, or just save for one until I am ready to pull the trigger. The M6 is a more expensive machine with the same RAM and storage specs, but you’ll still find a couple configs at up to $149 off via Amazon right now:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099)

Amazon still delivering new HomeView on release day as Apple slips into December

Apple’s new HomeView has been popular around here and, while not quite as delayed iPhone Duo is at this point, shipments have now slid into December for most colorways. Amazon is, however, still delivering a few color options on release day still.

The light early discount on all but the Rose Pink model have come and gone for now – it was only $10 off or so – but you can still score the seemingly more popular Space Gray and Starlight models on release day from Amazon. Apple still has the Rose Pink model landing on time, but that one still less pricey at Amazon anyway.

As of the time of writing it appears Apple can’t deliver these two or the Silver model until late November and more like early December at this point. If you are looking to score yours on the November 13 release day, Amazon still has the Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose Pink models listed as arrived arriving on November 13 for most locations across the country.

We will keep a close eye on the listings, but considering how many of these things are already flying off the shelves, it might be a good idea to consider securing one now before the Amazon delivery date slips as well.

Dates will likely continue to get pushed deeper into December straight from Apple as time goes on, and it is likely only a matter of time before the Amazon listings bump beyond launch day.

The same goes for the new Apple TV 4K – Apple’s delivery times are landing somewhere between November 24 and early December at this point. Amazon is still serving up a light pre-order discount and shipping them on the November 13 release date.

SANDMARC debuts new full-grain leather iPhone Duo case with metal mount [Exclusive deal]

We have already covered the new SANDMARC iPhone 18 Pro leather cases, and now it’s time to take a look at its iPhone Duo model. The new SANDMARC iPhone Duo Pro Leather Case is now available for pre-order and you can get the lowest price possible using our exclusive 9TO510 promo code at checkout.

I have been a big fan of the SANDMARC leather iPhone cases for a few years now. They are, perhaps, not for everyone due to the industrial-grade and particularly functional metal housing employed to both safeguard your camera lenses and provide an attachment point for its lens add-ons, but they are very much for me.

  • SANDMARC iPhone Duo Pro Leather Case $81 (Reg. $90)
  • Using code 9TO510 at checkout

The new Duo model follows along the same lines as its 18 Pro models with a full-grain leather build and its patented aluminum mount “that delivers both camera protection and a secure connection to SANDMARC lenses and filters.”

You’ll also find a hard-shell guard for “added screen protection,” the expected MagSafe charging action, and an optional front guard – the brand says it “snaps in, with adhesive for a firmer hold” or you can “trim the pull tab to skip it.”

Burton Goods leather iPhone Duo cases are here: Up to 30% off for 9to5 readers

Don’t pay full list for Pitaka’s aramid fiber iPhone Duo Case, it’s down at $50 on Amazon

Don’t pay full price for iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C), Amazon has it for less

Anker’s all-new 45W–65W Burgundy Neo charger with Apple-like dynamic power hits lowest price at $20

Over at Amazon, you’ll find Anker’s official storefront offering Prime members its new Nano Charger Neo Dynamic 45W–65W model in Burgundy for $19.99 shipped. This is a brand-new release that recently debuted at $26 as a more affordable alternative to Apple’s Dynamic Power Adapter. We’ve seen this charger in other finishes drop lower during the recent fall Prime Day sale, but this is the first deal we’re tracking on the Burgundy variant. It’s a great nice match if you picked up one of the new Burgundy iPhone 18 Pro models, or simply missed the earlier discounts on this charger. Head below for more details.

Anker’s new Neo Charger is similar to Apple’s Dynamic Power Adapter, offering variable output instead of sticking to a fixed ceiling. It delivers 45W under normal use but can ramp up to 65W when a connected device needs more power, giving you extra headroom for those that actually need it, like the iPhone 18 Pro/Max, MacBooks, and so on. This Adjustable Voltage Supply, or AVS, allows for this intelligent charging, and it more than makes up for not having a Smart Display like the one you get on the brand’s 45W Nano charger. This one also has a 180-degree foldable plug, ActiveShield 4.0 temperature monitoring, and a compact body that’s easy to toss in your EDC or travel kit.

Be sure to check out the deals on Belkin’s latest Qi2.2 25W magnetic charging stations, which are now starting from $50. You’ll also find plenty of other discounted gear over at our smartphone accessories hub, so be sure to check that out as well.

Belkin Qi2.2 25W Pro magnetic charging stations deals live from $50 today

We have the 2-in-1 foldable model as well as the 3-in-1 magnetic wireless charging station at some of the lowest prices to date. Those offers also join a 20% drop on its pop-up travel model at 20% off as well. Details below.

Belkin Charging Stations

  • Belkin Qi2.2 25W UltraCharge 2-in-1 Foldable Charging Station $50 (Reg. $60)
  • Belkin Qi2.2 25W UltraCharge Pro 2-in-1 Travel Charging Station $80 (Reg. $100)
  • Belkin Qi2.2 25W UltraCharge 3-in-1 Charging Station $55 (Reg. $65)

While all of these models were at all-time low pricing for fall Prime Day earlier this month, if you missed out there you can score some of the lowest prices otherwise here today.

Deals have been somewhat rare on these Belkin 25W models since release – today’s offers are somewhere in the range of $5 to $14 or so more than the fall Prime Day prices and, by and large, the next best discounts we have tracked.
